evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, run() still converts a None return from drain() into {"status":"drained"} and exits 0. That makes an early no-start path indistinguishable from a completed drain in the JSON artifact, while nearby early exits already use explicit paused/deferred/busy statuses. No current-contract clause supersedes this, and there is no fixing commit for the conversion. This is routine status-reporting correctness, not a new approval or protection requirement.
